steps: Replay via MCP conkay_solve {solver_id: math.roots, typed inputs from the reference case} (or solve.direct once SC-00 lands): {coefficients: [1, 0, -2], bracket: [1, 2]} target brent → PASS, root √2 with residual ~1e-16; the same polynomial under target newton from a declared start checks beside it, and the MINPACK Rosenbrock system from its standard start (−1.2, 1) → the known root (1, 1) — expected values from Numerical Recipes 3e / the MINPACK test set (ANL-80-74), never from the solver's output.

Bracket-honesty leg: {coefficients: [1, 0, -2], bracket: [2, 3]} → NOT_COMPUTED no_bracket_sign_change — the bracket is never widened or assumed; Newton's start is declared and echoed in the record (Newton is start-dependent and the record says so); a vanishing derivative or a divergence is NOT_COMPUTED, named.

Check the envelope: status, outputs within the declared tolerance, inputs echo (inputs used == inputs submitted); the full root set (degree ≤ 20, Durand–Kerner) serves only when EVERY root's residual |p(z)| ≤ 1e-8 · coefficient scale — otherwise NOT_COMPUTED naming the failure, with clustered or multiple roots beyond reach naming the companion-eigenvalue engine tier; system solves are verified by residual ≤ 1e-12 and a singular Jacobian mid-iteration is NOT_COMPUTED with the iterate named; Newton–Krylov / trust-region methods and general (non-polynomial) function inputs → requires_engine_tier:minpack.

Adversarial: NaN / 1e300 input → INVALID_INPUT with the field named; missing coefficients, bracket, or start → NOT_COMPUTED naming the field; a substituted input → NOT_COMPUTED input_substituted; a bare number on a dimensional input → refused unless the unit is declared (SC-04 leg, expected-fail until built).
